result.topic_en: A variational (minimum) principle for two interpenetrating media u and v, coupled by a term proportional to (u−v)^2, with the resulting equations of motion and a trial periodic solution in time.
result.transcription:
$x(t+\partial t)$
$\int \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial t^2} dx_1 dx_2 dx_3 \partial t^2 + \alpha\alpha \int \Sigma (\Delta u)^2 dx_1 dx_2 dx_3 + \beta\beta \int \Sigma \left(\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_1}+\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_2}+\frac{\partial u_3}{\partial x_3}\right)^2 dx_1 dx_2 dx_3 + [-\mu-] \mu\int \Sigma (u-v)^2 dx_1 dx_2 dx_3$
$+ \gamma \int \frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial t^2} dx_1 dx_2 dx_3 \partial t^2 = $ Min.
$u_1 \; u_2 \; u_3 \qquad u_1 + \frac{\partial \lambda}{\partial x_1} = w_1$ [?]
$\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_1}+\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_2}+\frac{\partial u_3}{\partial x_3}$ [-...-] [?] $u_1 - v_1 = w_1$ [?]
Elasticität [?] proportional
$\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial t^2} + \alpha\alpha\, \Delta_1 \Delta u + \beta\beta \frac{\partial}{\partial x_1}\left(\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_1}+\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_2}+\frac{\partial u_3}{\partial x_3}\right) + \mu (u_1 - v_1) = 0$
$\gamma \frac{\partial^2 v_1}{\partial t^2} + \mu (v_1 - u_1) = 0$
$\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial t^2} = -nn\, u \qquad u_1 = e^{\pm n t i} A$
